index.title: LearnHoro — LearnHoro (BPHS)
index.sub: A source-grounded curriculum for Brihat Parashara Hora Shastra — from first principles to chart synthesis.

grahas.title: The Nine Grahas — LearnHoro (BPHS)
grahas.sub: Full profiles of the Sun through Ketu, the natural benefics and malefics, and the working classifications.

dignity.title: Planetary Dignity & Relationships — LearnHoro (BPHS)
dignity.sub: Exaltation, debilitation, Moolatrikona and own sign; the three tiers of friendship; combustion, war and retrogression; and the nodes.

rashis.title: The Twelve Rashis — LearnHoro (BPHS)
rashis.sub: Every sign profiled, plus the modality, element, parity, rising-type, fertility and Kalapurusha classifications that drive later technique.

bhavas.title: The Twelve Bhavas — LearnHoro (BPHS)
bhavas.sub: House significations and karakas in depth, functional classes, bhava-lord placements with a worked case, house strength, and how a house prospers or breaks.

lagna.title: Lagna & Special Ascendants — LearnHoro (BPHS)
lagna.sub: The rising point that anchors the chart, the twelve ascendant temperaments, and the computed Bhava, Hora, Ghatika, Arudha, Sree and Prana ascendants.

vargas.title: Shodasha Vargas — LearnHoro (BPHS)
vargas.sub: All sixteen divisional charts, how to read a varga, and the significance of each of the twelve houses within every chart that is read as a chart.

aspects.title: Aspects — Graha & Rashi Drishti — LearnHoro (BPHS)
aspects.sub: Planetary aspects with the graded glances and Virupa values, sign aspects in full, aspects on houses, and when to use which system.

strength.title: Strength — Shadbala, Bhava Bala & Ishta/Kashta — LearnHoro (BPHS)
strength.sub: Every Shadbala component and its sub-parts and minimums, house strength, benefic vs difficult potency, and Vimsopaka divisional strength.

special-points.title: Arudhas, Argala, Karakas & Karakamsa — LearnHoro (BPHS)
special-points.sub: Image-points and how to read the Arudha Lagna and Upapada, interventions, both karaka schemes, and the Karakamsa lagna.

yogas.title: Yogas — the full catalogue — LearnHoro (BPHS)
yogas.sub: Yogakaraka, the five Mahapurusha yogas, lunar and solar yogas, the 32 Nabhasa yogas, Raja and Dhana yogas, Parivartana, Vipareeta and Neechabhanga, and the arishta and penury combinations.

avasthas-longevity.title: Avasthas, Longevity & Maraka — LearnHoro (BPHS)
avasthas-longevity.sub: The five avastha schemes, and the longevity methods and Maraka doctrine — presented academically, with care.

dashas.title: Dashas — LearnHoro (BPHS)
dashas.sub: Vimshottari with worked balance-at-birth and sub-period examples, the conditional nakshatra dashas, and the rasi (sign) dashas of BPHS.

ashtakavarga.title: Ashtakavarga — LearnHoro (BPHS)
ashtakavarga.sub: Benefic-point rules, Bhinna- and Sarvashtakavarga with reading thresholds, kakshas, the three shodhanas, and transit interpretation.
